ICS:
Assign one person to play the role of the physician and one to be the mother; role play delivery of the information to the family and lead students to consider the following:
Would you have the 11 yo child stay in the room or step out? What information do you share with the child?
How might the family react to this news in terms of the new understanding of the child’s issues and the late age of diagnosis?
How might the child feel knowing that there is a reason for his differences in learning and speech?
How might they feel about the chance of physical issues not yet diagnosed? mental health issues?
Do you think the family will want to know everything at once or not?
Might they feel grief, relief, overwhelmed, guilty, empowered?
What information might be available to help the family adjust to this diagnosis?
